Deliver derived links and mixed retrieval while preserving independent canonical stores and solver inputs.

## Scope

- Derived memory sidecars

- Immutable ontology packets
- Manager reassessment

## Exit criteria

- Every phase task meets its criteria and planned verification with current evidence; relevant preservation checks pass.

## Risks

- A semantic association is not an approved assertion or evidence that an event happened.
- Live source changes or sibling output must never leak into frozen solver context.

## TASK-019 - Generate derived memory links without record changes

Implement explicit link-memory using accessible selected memory records and resolvable concepts, storing deterministic derived associations with exact record/ontology versions under .sys4ai/ontology/links/.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Status | `planned` |
| State reason | None |
| Skip authority | None |
| Requirements | REQ-006, REQ-015, REQ-021, REQ-035, REQ-036 |
| Design basis | None |
| Target artifacts | SKILLS-depo/ontology/scripts/ontology_memory.py, SKILLS-depo/ontology/tests/test_memory_links.py |
| Dependencies | None |
| Parallel group | None |
| Completed at | None |

### Risks

- Preserve unrelated bytes and stop on stale inputs or a scope conflict.

### Acceptance criteria

- The sidecar records derived status, exact record and concept versions, and ambiguous/unmatched associations; canonical memory and ontology remain unchanged.
- Stale source or ontology versions invalidate the association until an explicit rebuild; identical inputs reproduce identical links.

### Planned verification

- Build, repeat, stale and rebuild fixture links and compare record/schema/configuration hashes.
- Test excluded records, ambiguous labels, missing concepts and unauthorized cross-project input.

### Acceptance criteria

- A prior Task manager failure query resolves its vocabulary and returns actual permitted historical records or an accurate no-match/unavailable result.
- Expansion retains memory lifecycle/corpus/backend restrictions and cannot include child projects, excluded sources or newly published records in frozen contexts.
- Each result identifies its source type, record/concept identity, version, match route and freshness without elevating historical evidence into current authority.

## TASK-021 - Build and freeze bounded ontology packets

Implement an ontology-owned packet schema and explicit freeze operation after checking current manager, execution, generation and output scope, containing selected or empty ontology context with exact source/config/module versions.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Status | `planned` |
| State reason | None |
| Skip authority | None |
| Requirements | REQ-018, REQ-039, REQ-040, REQ-041 |
| Design basis | None |
| Target artifacts | SKILLS-depo/ontology/scripts/ontology_packet.py, SKILLS-depo/ontology/tests/test_packets.py |
| Dependencies | TASK-020 |
| Parallel group | None |
| Completed at | None |

### Risks

- Preserve unrelated bytes and stop on stale inputs or a scope conflict.

### Acceptance criteria

- Packet bytes contain selected identities, definitions, aliases, relations, constraints and exact source references, fit existing Task limits and use an external path/sha256 reference without a self-hash.
- Wrong manager/generation, ungranted output scope, sibling drafts and unavailable or unselected sources fail; an explicit empty packet is valid.
- The operation writes only its new immutable packet and never creates, upgrades or changes a Task.

### Planned verification

- Compare packet bounds and manager checks with the existing read-only Task helper and artifact registration interface.
- Run empty, oversized, stale-source, wrong-owner and prohibited-context fixtures.
